items.description: Section 3 excludes "the option help strings" and cites pylint/checkers/base/name_checker/checker.py:213 and pylint/lint/base_options.py:58. Neither line is a help string: :213 is "metavar": "<names>" with help at 214-215, and :58 is "default": (re.compile(r"^\.#"),) with help at 59-61. Both citations land one key before the one they name.
